relatedBrowser.command: pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright.agent-board.config.ts tests/agent-board.spec.ts tests/patterns.spec.ts tests/blog.spec.ts tests/registry-snapshot.spec.ts
relatedBrowser.scope: Related regression before final navigation/filter-label polish; final Agent tests rerun below.

finalAgentBrowser.command: pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright.agent-board.config.ts tests/agent-board.spec.ts tests/agent-board-blog.spec.ts
finalAgentBrowser.scope: Final source, four views, approval receipts, stale snapshots, drafts, URL/history, mobile/touch, locale/theme, redaction and usage. Approval reconciliation confirms only the request response, never tool completion. The 20 Agent cases passed; the separately added article case initially required an absolute image URL assertion and is checked separately.

independentInstall.scope: Fresh consumer installed agent-board-workspace and Registry dependency closure; its production build and browser selection/Sheet/List/Insights/missing-usage checks passed, together with existing common/Canvas consumers.

articleBrowser.scope: Source snapshot association, all twelve images, evidence downloads, 1440/768/390px overflow, English locale and workspace navigation. Image URLs are compared as absolute resolved URLs.

limitations: All Agent operations and observations use deterministic local fixtures.
Real execution, authorization, remote persistence and business acceptance are not validated.
No before/after performance comparison was measured; no percentage improvement is claimed.
Prior ENOSPC and long temporary-path browser launch failures were resolved and rerun; failed attempts are not counted as passes.
